highlights: Designed and deployed a **full-stack** performance appraisal platform to automate internal employee evaluations.
Developed a modular frontend using component-based **vanilla JavaScript** and **HTML/CSS**.
Engineered a **REST** backend with **Node.js** and **Express.js**, implementing custom Middleware for **JWT**-based authentication and Role-Based Access Control (**RBAC**).
Designed a **MySQL** relational schema to manage feedback workflows between employees and appraisers.
